text.arabic_uthmani: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا

words.gloss_range: opening connector of immediate sequence, with response and resumption pressure after the prior crisis
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) opens the ayah as an immediate response-beat after Maryam's crisis in 19:23. Its payoff is not only sequence but compression: the call enters with no narrative delay, so consolation is heard as the next movement inside the same pressure, not as a detached later scene.

topics.headline: immediate response link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as an immediate answer to the crisis in 19:23, not as a disconnected new scene.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction is attached to the calling verb and opens the next narrated event after Maryam's prior speech.

topics.headline: hinge fused to the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the transition itself: the sequence marker is fused to the call, making the movement from distress to address structurally tight.
topics.reason: The written proclitic binds the connector directly to the following verb, matching the ayah's pivot from the preceding crisis into address.

words.gloss_range: a directed calling event toward Maryam, completed in narration, with the caller left grammatically unexpressed and the speech content opened by the verb
words.root_gloss_range: calling, summoning, gathering, and associated generosity or moistness images; the local verb selects directed vocal summons while secondary root pressure may color the scene
words.prose: {{ar:نادا}} ({{tr:nādā}}) makes the response arrive as a completed directed call, not neutral reporting of speech. The attached object makes Maryam the recipient inside the verb, so the one who wished for forgottenness in 19:23 is immediately singled out by address. The unexpressed subject keeps the caller's identity controlled but open; that openness matters because the following source phrase and variant evidence make the beneath-space interpretively charged before the quoted consolation begins. The call also belongs to Surah Maryam's wider calling pattern, including 19:3 and 19:7, while the root's gathering and moisture-giving pressure only anticipates provision without replacing the local sense of vocal summons.

topics.headline: directed completed call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that consolation reaches Maryam as a targeted summons whose recipient is built into the verb.
topics.reason: The local verb carries perfect aspect and takes the attached object suffix as its direct object.

topics.headline: controlled caller uncertainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the caller is not named in the base grammar, so speaker identity remains a structured issue rather than a detail the surface resolves.
topics.reason: The verb has 3ms agreement with no overt same-clause subject; variant evidence may clarify possibilities, but the aligned surface itself leaves the subject unexpressed.

topics.headline: gate into quoted consolation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb organizing the ayah as call, source, message, and proof rather than as a flat report.
topics.reason: The attachment data makes the later negative command and explanation the quoted complement of the calling clause.

topics.headline: call-root echo register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this call within a wider register of urgent and divine-adjacent summons, including the same surah's calling pattern.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows support call-register echoes, while local grammar still selects the immediate directed call rather than importing every root image as the local sense.

topics.headline: latent wetness and giving pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice a secondary root pressure that anticipates provision and gathering without replacing the local sense of calling.
topics.reason: The local form is a speech verb, so the wetness or gathering material survives only as root-image pressure adjacent to the later provision.

topics.headline: erasure answered by address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Maryam's wish to disappear in 19:23 is answered by a call that singles her out.
topics.reason: The direct object suffix makes Maryam the addressed recipient, reversing the prior boundary movement from self-erasure into received address.

words.gloss_range: source preposition governing the first beneath phrase, with accepted variant pressure that can resegment the word as a relative pronoun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: accepted contrastive relative-pronoun reading that can turn the source phrase into a personal-agent phrase

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the first below-phrase the source of the call. The accepted {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) pressure is important as contrast: a small recitational shift can turn source-location into personal-agent focused on the one beneath her, but the aligned surface here remains the preposition that foregrounds where the call comes from before what the call says. As the first half of the ayah's double-below frame, this source phrase prepares the later below-you placement of the gift.

topics.headline: source before speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first fixes the call's unusual source before reporting the consoling words.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following spatial noun and attaches to the calling verb as its source complement.

topics.headline: source-agent variant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how close the standard source reading stands to a variant personal-agent reading focused on the one beneath her.
topics.reason: The accepted contrast can illuminate agent-source pressure, but the aligned local surface remains a preposition and must not be replaced by the variant parse.

topics.headline: first half of double below-frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first below-phrase preparing the later below-you placement, so beneath becomes the ayah's organizing axis.
topics.reason: The first governed source phrase is matched later by an adverbial below-you phrase in the provision clause.

words.gloss_range: governed below-her or below-it source phrase for the call, with feminine suffix reference locally live and a river-beneath register preparing the final gift
words.root_gloss_range: below, underside, lower position, and support-layer imagery; frequent Quranic use in river-beneath and garden formulas gives this local below-space provision pressure
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْتِهَا}} ({{tr:taḥtihā}}) makes the call come from a measured below-space rather than from an unspecified source. The suffix-bound form makes that underside relational and bounded, but the feminine suffix should be kept to a local feminine anchor because the reference evidence leaves more than one nearby anchor live. The word also begins the ayah's double-below structure: the first below is source of the voice, while the later below-you becomes the place of provision. Its support-layer and river-beneath pressure lets the private birth scene brush against broader beneath-river formulas such as 14:23 and 7:43 without overriding the local source syntax.

topics.headline: governed source below
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices below as the source coordinate of the call, not a loose scenic backdrop.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preceding preposition and functions as the source complement of the calling verb.

topics.headline: feminine suffix as local anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the below-space is relationally measured from a feminine local anchor, while the evidence warns against over-resolving the antecedent.
topics.reason: The suffix is feminine singular, but the cross-reference evidence marks the antecedent as ambiguous between nearby compatible anchors; claims of absolute unambiguity must therefore be narrowed.

topics.headline: below-space primed for provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this below-space is already loaded with support and river-beneath pressure before the final provision word appears.
topics.reason: The local sense remains spatial below-source, while the recurrence field makes the later stream reading easier to hear.

topics.headline: first formal half of double below
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same spatial lexeme return later with a changed role, turning one vertical zone from voice-source into gift-location.
topics.reason: The first occurrence is a governed nominal source phrase and the second occurrence is an adverbial location under the making verb.

topics.headline: private below-river echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can compare the private birth scene with broader river-beneath formulas such as 14:23 and 7:43 without letting those formulas override the local syntax.
topics.reason: The rows name real formulaic parallels, while local grammar keeps this occurrence as the call's source phrase.

topics.headline: bounded underside sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear and see the below-space as bounded and relational, not as an abstract direction.
topics.reason: The suffix-bound spatial noun compresses the place and its referent into one relational form.

words.gloss_range: fused complementizer-plus-negation that introduces the quoted prohibition and scopes negation over the grief verb
words.prose: {{ar:أَلَّا}} ({{tr:allā}}) carries dependency and negation together. It turns the call into quoted consolation and keeps the negation focused on the grief verb, so the first content of the speech is not explanation but an emotionally addressed prohibition. The compound also lets purpose and message converge: the call arrives so that Maryam not remain in grief.

topics.headline: fused negative complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dependence and negation arrive as one surface unit before the addressed grief verb.
topics.reason: The particle is analyzed as a fused complementizer and negation governing the following verb.

topics.headline: negation scoped to grief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees grief itself placed at the center of the call before the reason for reassurance is supplied.
topics.reason: The negative command clause sits between source and proof, and the negation scopes over the grief verb rather than the whole situation.

topics.headline: purpose and message fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the call's purpose and its spoken content converge: the call arrives so that Maryam not remain in grief.
topics.reason: The compound particle introduces the quoted complement while also carrying negative-purpose force.

words.gloss_range: addressed feminine singular grief prohibition, targeting an ongoing inward state and moving toward proof of completed provision
words.root_gloss_range: the aligned root evidence flags a rare or corrected field with cutting or incision pressure, while the local surface functions as the standard grief command; the grief sense remains selected
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْزَنِي}} ({{tr:taḥzanī}}) makes the first message personal: the addressed feminine verb targets Maryam's continuing grief, not an abstract condition. Its intransitive shape leaves the cause unnamed, so the state itself is interrupted. The possible {{ar:ح ز ز}} ({{tr:ḥ-z-z}}) cut-image is best kept as narrowed pressure: it gives grief a bodily edge in a labor scene, while the local command still means do not grieve. The wording also joins a grief-prohibition reassurance pattern, especially the mother-in-crisis scene in 28:7, and here the prohibition is immediately grounded by already accomplished provision before the next action movement in 19:25.

topics.headline: direct feminine grief command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Maryam is grammatically addressed as the specific feminine recipient of consolation.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is governed by the preceding particle and carries second feminine singular marking.

topics.headline: ongoing grief state interrupted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the command addresses an ongoing inner state before naming any material provision.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect and intransitive in the local frame, so the command targets the state of grieving rather than one named object.

topics.headline: cut-image narrowed under grief sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel grief as bodily constriction or incision in the labor scene without replacing the selected grief sense.
topics.reason: The root assignment is flagged as rare or corrected, so cutting imagery must remain secondary pressure while the local formula and context select grief.

topics.headline: reassurance formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the grief prohibition as part of a divine-consolation pattern, including the mother-in-crisis scene in 28:7.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete reassurance parallels, and this local command shares the grief-prohibition plus provision movement.

topics.headline: grief command grounded by proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition is not bare comfort; it is immediately grounded in an already accomplished provision.
topics.reason: The command is followed by the certainty particle and perfect making verb, making the second clause the reason for the first.

topics.headline: self-erasure becomes second-person address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the movement from prior first-person despair into a second-person command that redirects grief toward action.
topics.reason: The addressed verb reverses the prior boundary of self-erasure and prepares the later concrete command sequence.

words.gloss_range: certainty or realization particle before a perfect verb, turning the following placement into accomplished proof
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) begins the proof clause. Before the perfect making verb, it presents the provision as already realized, so the prohibition of grief is supported by accomplished fact rather than by a future promise alone. As a separate clipped onset before the action verb, it makes the explanatory half sound like firm news for a distressed addressee.

topics.headline: already accomplished certainty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reason not to grieve rests on a completed act already in place.
topics.reason: The particle precedes a perfect verb and marks the following divine making as verified and realized.

topics.headline: pivot from command to proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's second half functioning as evidence for the emotional command.
topics.reason: The particle starts the explanatory clause that follows the negative grief command.

topics.headline: audible decisive onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a clipped onset that marks the explanatory statement as firm news.
topics.reason: The particle stands independently before the verb and gives the proof clause a marked beginning.

words.gloss_range: completed divine making, placing, or appointing in a clause with explicit subject, fronted location, and final object
words.root_gloss_range: making, placing, appointing, setting into function, and causing to be in a role; local grammar emphasizes purposeful placement rather than only origination
words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) converts the proof clause into placed provision. The verb is perfect, its subject is named after it, and its frame holds location before object: Maryam hears that her Lord has already put or appointed something beneath her before the gift is finally named. The contrast with a pure creation verb should be narrowed to payoff: this verb keeps arrangement, disclosure, and function in view. The same divine-making register that announced the sign in 19:21 now becomes material relief, so the action answers the death-wish of 19:23 with a completed life-giving placement.

topics.headline: completed placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision as an accomplished placement in Maryam's reachable space.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect, has an explicit subject, governs the below-you adverbial, and takes the final direct object.

topics.headline: action before named subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the accomplished action first and then the subject who guarantees it: Maryam's Lord.
topics.reason: The masculine singular verb precedes and agrees with the explicit divine subject that follows.

topics.headline: making as purposeful placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is not merely that provision exists, but that it is appointed and positioned for Maryam.
topics.reason: The local location phrase licenses placing and appointing pressure; broader creation contrast remains interpretive pressure, not a replacement of the local frame.

topics.headline: divine making formula localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a broad divine-making formula concentrated into one immediate bodily provision scene.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence supports frequent divine making and Lord-making pairings, while the local clause specializes the formula to the provision beneath Maryam.

topics.headline: miracle announcement becomes provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the earlier miraculous making in 19:21 with the concrete provision announced in 19:24.
topics.reason: The same root appears in the surah's miracle sequence, and here it moves from announced sign to immediate relief.

topics.headline: where before what
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause fixing the gift's place before revealing the gift's identity.
topics.reason: The adverbial location precedes the direct object in the local word order.

topics.headline: death-wish answered by making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the action verb as the firm turn from wished extinction to life-giving provision.
topics.reason: The perfect verb, not an active participle, names an accomplished act at the boundary after the prior death-wish.

words.gloss_range: singular construct divine title with feminine second-person suffix, explicit subject of the making verb and personal agent of provision
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, nurturing, sustaining, rearing, and governing; local use names the provider as Maryam's Lord with care and authority combined
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكِ}} ({{tr:rabbuki}}) names the agent who makes the provision. The title is not generic: the feminine suffix binds lordship to Maryam in direct address, while the nominative role makes her Lord, not the unnamed caller as such, the subject of the placement. The root's nurturing pressure fits the scene because the provision is an act of sustaining care. The same suffix cadence then pairs Mary's Lord-relation with the below-you location, and the title carries the surah's Lord-address thread from earlier reassurance scenes such as 19:21 into this private provision.

topics.headline: explicit subject of placement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the provision is grounded in an identified divine subject rather than in the unresolved caller alone.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative and functions as the explicit subject of the making verb.

topics.headline: personal feminine lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the divine title as personally addressed to Maryam, not as an abstract title detached from her crisis.
topics.reason: The construct title carries a second feminine singular suffix, continuing the direct address from the grief verb.

topics.headline: lordship as nurturing provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the agent is named with a title of sustaining care, so the placed gift reads as nurture as well as authority.
topics.reason: The root-family evidence supports tending and sustaining pressure, and the local object is a provision placed for Maryam.

topics.headline: Lord makes the below-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the Lord-relation and the below-location bound to the same addressee.
topics.reason: The clause places the divine subject between the making verb and the below-you location, and the repeated feminine suffix links relation and location.

topics.headline: same-surah lordship thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this private provision to Surah Maryam's repeated Lord-address pattern, including 19:21.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah rows show the title recurring in prayer, announcement, and reassurance, with this occurrence anchoring the birth-scene provision.

topics.headline: specific nominal title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency comes through a definite relational title, not through an impersonal description of power.
topics.reason: The noun is a singular construct title with an attached suffix, matching the root's dominant nominal deployment.

words.gloss_range: second-person below-you adverbial location governed by the making verb, marking the provision site and beneficiary access
words.root_gloss_range: below, underside, lower position, and support-layer imagery; here the root returns as an adverbial provision-location addressed directly to Maryam
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْتَكِ}} ({{tr:taḥtaki}}) turns the earlier below-source into a below-you provision site. Grammatically it is the location governed by the making verb, not an adjective of the final object. The suffix shift from her to you re-centers the same vertical space on Maryam in direct address, while the repeated suffix also pairs Mary's Lord-relation with the location of the gift. Because the provision is placed within reach, the lower space becomes support and beneficiary access, not only coordinate. Its position before the final object makes where the gift is arrive before what the gift is, and the river-beneath register is localized into this private below-you phrase.

topics.headline: adverbial provision location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices below-you as the event location controlled by the making verb, not as a loose modifier of the gift.
topics.reason: The word is tagged as an adverbial place expression and attaches to the making verb.

topics.headline: below re-centered on Maryam
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the spatial frame shift from third-person beneath-her to direct second-person beneath-you.
topics.reason: The repeated spatial lexeme changes suffix from feminine third person to second feminine singular in the quoted address.

topics.headline: Lord relation and location paired
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same feminine suffix binding Maryam's relation to her Lord and the location of provision.
topics.reason: The same second feminine singular suffix appears on the divine title and the below-you location.

topics.headline: below as reachable support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the lower space transformed from a place of vulnerability into reachable support.
topics.reason: The local phrase is locative, but the provision is positioned relative to the addressee, so location and access converge.

topics.headline: double below spatial axis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's vertical axis: the voice comes from below and the gift is placed below.
topics.reason: The same root occurs twice in different syntactic roles, creating a paired source-location and gift-location frame.

topics.headline: river-beneath register localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the wider river-beneath register concentrated into Maryam's private below-you phrase.
topics.reason: The recurrence pressure supports the stream register, while the local grammar still makes this word the adverbial location of the provision.

topics.headline: where before what
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause establishes the gift's location before revealing the gift's identity.
topics.reason: The below-you phrase immediately precedes the final object and prepares the word that names the provision.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative final object of the making verb, locally carrying stream and noble-person pressures with strong water/provision pull from the beneath frame
words.root_gloss_range: flowing or traveling by night, watercourse or rivulet, and noble or eminent person; local closure keeps stream strongly licensed while variant and form evidence preserve noble-person pressure
words.prose: {{ar:سَرِيًّاً}} ({{tr:sariyyā}}) is the final revealed object of the proof clause. Its accusative indefinite form makes the gift arrive as one newly disclosed provision after the location has been fixed, and the tanwīn gives that new object an audible landing. The word should not be flattened to a single generic gift: the below-river frame strongly activates the stream reading, while variant and qualitative-form pressure keep noble-person resonance alive at the closure. Its rare form, quiet flow and night-movement pressure, and private compression of river-beneath formulas such as 14:23 and 7:43 make the final word a life-bearing answer to the despair of 19:23.

topics.headline: final indefinite object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gift as one newly introduced object, revealed only after the location is established.
topics.reason: The word is accusative singular and functions as the direct object of the making verb after the below-you location.

topics.headline: stream and noble-person tension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word can carry both stream and noble-person pressure, with the local beneath frame pulling especially toward water.
topics.reason: Dictionary and variant evidence preserve both pressures, while the standard source-location and repeated below frame strongly license the stream reading locally.

topics.headline: hidden flow and movement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the provision as quiet, moving, and life-bearing rather than static.
topics.reason: The local noun is the placed provision; root images of flow and night movement survive as semantic pressure, not as a separate travel event.

topics.headline: rare qualitative form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final provision word is morphologically marked and rare, increasing its interpretive weight.
topics.reason: The contextual rows mark the root and local qualitative form as rare, and the local word bears the clause's final object role.

topics.headline: resolution word at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah resolve by naming the gift only in the final word.
topics.reason: The object is delayed until after the location and closes the ayah, making it the endpoint of the proof clause.

topics.headline: private river-formula compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares the solitary gift beneath Maryam with broader river-beneath formulas such as 14:23 and 7:43, but now compressed into one private provision.
topics.reason: The concrete inter-ayah rows support a river-beneath comparison, while the local object remains a singular provision in Maryam's scene.

topics.headline: audible flowing closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word's sound and indefinite ending reinforce the arrival of a newly named, flowing provision.
topics.reason: The final indefinite ending and smooth sound pattern coincide with the word's position as the ayah's closing object.

topics.headline: life-bearing answer to despair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior death-wish answered by a final word of life-bearing presence, whether heard as stream or noble one.
topics.reason: The final object concentrates lexical ambiguity, rarity, and closure force as the concrete answer to the prior crisis.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call, doubled تَحْت, prohibition of grief, divine making, and سَرِيّ form one downward-oriented clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: An audible intervention redirects attention downward, where the Lord transforms an underside marked by psychic and terrain-like roughness into a running passage of care.

activation_trace.role: Raised calling supplies the audible intervention that begins the relief mechanism.
Repeated lower location makes downward orientation the ayah's spatial frame.
Psychic roughness identifies grief as a textured state to be altered.
Rough terrain lets the grief-root project the same texture onto the setting.
Transformation into a new state supplies the arrow from roughness to usable relief.
Nurture and completion make the Lord's action sustained care rather than bare placement.
Running flow supplies the material passage made below her.

changed_reading.before: A voice reassures her and points out a stream.
changed_reading.after: The ayah performs a downward reorientation in which divine care converts both affective and spatial roughness into a traversable flow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَادَى opens the ayah and سَرِيّ closes the clause of the Lord's making.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split call-root inventory carries sound, wetness, and generosity, while the final running current concretizes the call as a gift; message and provision become coordinated modes of one relief event.

activation_trace.role: The audible call supplies the communicative face of the event.
Dew, rain, and wetness supply a material echo inside the call-root inventory.
Generosity turns the wet echo into a bestowed rather than accidental resource.
Nurturing care joins communication to provision.
The running current gives the call's wet and generous overtones a visible endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Spoken reassurance precedes an independently supplied stream.
changed_reading.after: Voice and water can be heard as two surfaces of one gift: the call itself arrives already charged with wetness and generosity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled language of below stands directly beside a final noun whose inventory includes elevation and distinction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Physical low position and a branch of social lowness are juxtaposed with the elevation of سَرِيّ; divine making can therefore stage a rank reversal without deciding whether the final noun names a current or a noble being.

activation_trace.role: Literal below supplies the physical low pole of the reversal.
The socially low branch supplies a status overlay without replacing the locative syntax.
Elevation and distinction supply the high pole held beneath her.
Making into a state allows low position to carry newly conferred rank.
The call gives the below-positioned source an active voice.

changed_reading.before: Below is only a location and سَرِيّ only a resource.
changed_reading.after: The clause may superimpose a status paradox: what speaks or appears from the lowest position already bears elevation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Divine making occurs twice within the frame of below and ends on the split س ر ي inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The س ر ي target of uncovering and the mapped س ر ر images of concealment and hidden joy permit the final object to function as an event: relief stored out of sight is made available from the underside.

activation_trace.role: The underside supplies the concealed zone from which relief emerges.
Bringing something into being supplies the transition from unavailable to present.
Uncovering gives the final noun an eventive release function.
Hidden interiority supplies what had been inaccessible beneath the visible crisis.
Hidden joy supplies the affect released against grief.

changed_reading.before: A fixed object is newly noticed below her.
changed_reading.after: The ending can also register an uncovering: concealed relief and joy become operative from precisely where she had not been looking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the prohibition of grief into an embodied regulation sequence: labor's agitation is answered by movement, downward delivery of moist food, eating and drinking, and the settling of the eye.

activation_trace.role: Psychic roughness is the affective state the care sequence must change.
Running flow supplies immediate material relief beneath her.
The pregnant body's disturbance supplies the acute state immediately preceding the call.
Deliberate shaking converts passive distress into bodily action.
Downward falling extends the ayah's repeated below-axis into delivered food.
Moist softness counters the dryness and roughness carried by grief.
Eating turns the provided environment into bodily restoration.
Drinking confirms that the current belongs to an actionable care regimen.
The eye's settling supplies the sequence's explicit affective endpoint.

structural_cues: 19:23 places labor and the palm immediately before the focus call.
19:25-26 continue with commanded motion, downward fruit, intake, and settled vision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agitation, movement, falling food, intake, and settled vision; I infer that material support causes affective regulation. A live alternative is that these are adjacent benefits rather than one causal care sequence.

changed_reading.before: Do not grieve is verbal consolation supported by nearby water.
changed_reading.after: Do not grieve initiates a postpartum care protocol in which movement, hydration, nourishment, and sensory settling materially produce relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context develops a transfer of speech: a voice comes from below, Mary binds her own tongue, points instead of answering, and meaningful prophetic speech then comes from the infant in the cradle.

activation_trace.role: The raised call establishes speech emerging before Mary resumes public contact.
Below locates the alternative speaking source on the infant's later spatial axis.
Elevation makes a noble child-reading of the below-positioned source available.
Restraint of the tongue removes Mary as the direct public speaker.
Meaningful speech names the channel Mary explicitly withholds.
Hand indication transfers the answering role away from Mary's tongue.
The crowd's question makes intelligible speech from the child the explicit problem.
The prepared cradle fixes the new speaker in a low infant setting.
Infancy makes the relocation of authoritative speech maximally marked.
The child's utterance realizes speech from the low-positioned source.
Prophetic office supplies the elevated authority carried by that speech.

structural_cues: 19:24 introduces a call from below before the silence instruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a below-call, Mary's verbal abstention, her gesture, and the infant's speech; I infer a deliberate relocation of defensive speech to the child. The live alternative is an angelic speaker in 19:24 whose call only anticipates, rather than identifies with, the child's later voice.

changed_reading.before: An external speaker privately reassures Mary before an unrelated later miracle.
changed_reading.after: The call can begin a designed transfer of voice: Mary is defended by authoritative speech rising from the low position she indicates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated جَعَلَ links the promised child as sign and mercy, the focus gift beneath Mary, and the child's later prophetic and blessed status; the focus clause can therefore carry a status-making layer alongside material provision.

activation_trace.role: Making into a state first assigns the promised child a public function.
A visible sign specifies one status produced by the first making.
Merciful tenderness specifies the care-bearing purpose of that status.
The focus making becomes the middle link in the repeated status sequence.
Nurture and completion identify the maker's action as developmental.
Elevation permits the focus object to carry conferred distinction.
The child's own speech resumes the same making construction for prophetic status.
Prophethood names the elevated state produced by the later making.
A third contextual making extends status beyond the immediate scene.
Stable growing good supplies the enduring content of that status.

structural_cues: ج ع ل recurs at 19:21, 19:24, 19:30, and 19:31 around the same child-event.
The sequence moves from promised sign and mercy to the focus gift, then to prophet and blessed presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making constructions and their stated outcomes; I infer that 19:24 participates in the same status-conferral chain. A live alternative is that its making concerns only a stream while the repeated verb supplies thematic cohesion rather than shared reference.

changed_reading.before: The Lord has merely placed a stream beneath Mary.
changed_reading.after: The focus making may simultaneously announce an elevated person whose sign-bearing, prophetic, and blessed statuses unfold in the following speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope frames Mary between remembrance and attempted self-erasure: withdrawal culminates in wishing to be a discarded forgotten thing, while the focus call turns concealment toward announcement, sign, gesture, and a truth-bearing public account.

activation_trace.role: Recall after absence supplies the pericope's opening counterforce to erasure.
Withdrawal to a side begins Mary's movement out of social visibility.
The promised visible sign supplies the public destiny opposed to disappearance.
The discarded forgotten thing states the endpoint Mary desires immediately before the call.
Appearance and notification make the call a hinge from hiddenness toward disclosure.
The grief prohibition interrupts the affect driving the wish for erasure.
Visible indication carries testimony forward without Mary's speech.
Truth matching reality supplies the stable public account reached after the crisis.

structural_cues: The unit opens by commanding Mary's remembrance and reaches her wish to be forgotten immediately before 19:24.
After the call, a visible sign, Mary's gesture, the child's speech, and a truth formula replace self-erasure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the remember-forgotten opposition and later public signs; I infer that the call causally pivots Mary from desired deletion into mediated testimony. A live alternative is that it only relieves immediate pain while the public turn is separately staged.

changed_reading.before: The call stops a private episode of sadness.
changed_reading.after: The call arrests a movement toward social and mnemonic erasure, redirecting Mary into testimony that another voice will carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The family-burden branch of grief is activated by a womb-to-public-carrying sequence and then reversed when the child identifies himself through goodness to his mother; reassurance addresses a threatened maternal relation, not only solitary emotion.

activation_trace.role: Concern for dependents and family burden supplies the relational dimension of grief.
Nurture and completion answer the feared burden with sustained care.
Elevation keeps open the possibility that the reassurance concerns the child's worth.
The womb image locates mercy language inside the maternal body.
Hidden pregnancy supplies the inward form of Mary's burden.
Visible carrying converts the inward burden into a socially exposed one.
Motherhood becomes an explicit term in the crowd's accusation.
Filial goodness repairs the maternal relation under public pressure.

structural_cues: Mary carries the child inward at 19:22 and visibly before her people at 19:27.
The crowd invokes motherhood at 19:28, and the child answers with goodness to his mother at 19:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily carrying, public carrying, maternal accusation, and filial goodness; I infer that the focus reassurance recasts feared kinship burden as a cared-for bond. A live alternative is that the filial statement answers only the crowd and does not feed back into 19:24.

changed_reading.before: Mary is comforted as an isolated sufferer.
changed_reading.after: She is comforted as a mother whose feared dependent and public burden will become the very relation that speaks, honors, and repairs her.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant تندية branch of the call-root as movement between watering and pasture. It remains anchored in نَادَى and is reinforced by the immediate current-palm-date-drink sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a procedural overlay, not as the lexical meaning of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening call and final current bracket an instruction sequence that immediately moves from water to palm food and back to drinking.

activation_trace.role: The water-to-pasture shuttle supplies a routing image latent in the focus call-root.
The running current supplies the watering station.
The palm supplies the nearby food-bearing station.
Ripe dates specify the pasture-side yield.
Drinking completes the return to water within the care cycle.

changed_reading.after: The call may also cue an alternating route between two nearby resource stations, water and fruit, organizing Mary's recovery.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from س ر ي to the packet's mapped س ر ر navel branch and treats a stream as a bodily analogy. It remains anchored in the final focus root, doubled below-location, divine nurture, and the context's womb-pregnancy-labor chain, but it should be rendered as an umbilical resonance rather than a proposed dictionary sense or exclusive referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A running thing is made beneath Mary while the split final-root inventory includes the navel and the Lord-root includes feeding and growth.

activation_trace.role: The doubled underside supplies the bodily-spatial anchor for the analogy.
A running current supplies the flow side of the bodily analogy.
The navel branch supplies a hidden maternal-fetal conduit image.
Feeding and growth make the conduit an image of developmental provision.
The womb image supplies the maternal interior activated by the context.
Pregnancy supplies the hidden period of internal nourishment.
Labor supplies the transition from internal provision to external care.

changed_reading.before: The stream is only an external post-birth resource.
changed_reading.after: The external current may echo an internal life-sustaining conduit, marking continuity between gestational nurture and postpartum provision.

strongest_changes: The grief prohibition became an embodied regulation sequence of motion, water, food, and settled vision.
The below-call became the first node in a transfer of public speech from Mary to the infant.
Repeated ج ع ل made a noble-child status layer viable alongside the stream reading.
The call became a hinge from desired erasure into mediated testimony and maternal repair.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ت ح ت and the split inventories of ن د و, ر ب ب, and س ر ي let voice, water, status, hidden bodily nurture, and social reversal coexist without forcing a single referent.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet leaves the 19:24 speaker compatible with either an angelic voice or the child.
سَرِيّ can sustain a running-water reading, a noble-child reading, or a deliberate overlay of both.
The water-pasture shuttle and umbilical-current models are productive but depend on form-distant branches and require explicit qualification.

baseline.text: Aşağısından ona şöyle seslendi: Üzülme! Rabbin alt yanında bir su akıttı.

findings.text: Sesin ve suyun iki kez aşağıda konumlanması, en düşük yeri kederden kaçılacak nokta değil, teselli ve rızkın geldiği yer hâline çevirir.
Aşağıdaki akış, maddi suyun yanında onur veren bir rahatlama çağrışımını da taşıyabilir.

inter_ayah_rows.note: God's making and rivers flowing beneath gardens echo provision from below, though the setting is eschatological.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Provision from above and beneath the feet is a remote spatial counterpart to the stream beneath Mary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A call for water across the Fire and Garden contrasts sharply with Mary's immediate consoling provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rivers flowing beneath everlasting gardens give a broader positive image of water supplied from below.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger's immediately preceding announcement identifies the Lord who now reassures Mary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's direct call to Abraham parallels the responsive divine address, but the situation differs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Garden rivers beneath the blessed are only a broad water-from-below parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate sequel continues Mary's physical relief with dates after the stream is provided.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its garden rivers repeat a distant reward image rather than Mary's crisis provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Calling one's assembly is a public challenge, not the consoling call addressed to Mary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The mention of what lies beneath the soil supplies only a lexical spatial parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Fire above and below is an inverse image of the safe, life-giving source beneath Mary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A mother facing danger is told not to fear or grieve and is promised divine restoration.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mary's earlier question exposes the bewilderment that makes the later reassurance necessary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rivers beneath gardens retain only the general image of divine water provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rivers beneath the saved and their grateful speech join water-from-below with a received call, but in Paradise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate sequel completes the reassurance: Mary is told to eat, drink, and have a comforted eye.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The promise that the godfearing will not grieve generalizes the relief given directly to Mary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Garden rivers and good provision are a distant outcome parallel to Mary's concrete sustenance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The prayer for coolness of the eyes only lightly anticipates Mary's commanded comfort of eye.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The night passing has no material connection to Mary's call, grief, or stream.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Unexpected provision from God clarifies the trustful source of Mary's unanticipated sustenance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mary's labor pain and wish for death immediately set up the command not to grieve.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The broad promise of no fear or grief lacks the maternal crisis and supplied provision of this scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Angels tell the steadfast not to fear or grieve and bring good news, closely paralleling divine reassurance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Lord's declaration that the birth is easy and merciful directly grounds the care given in 19:24.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Night travel under pursuit has no close link to Mary's stationary childbirth scene.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's forgiveness and punishment describe the Lord generally but do not illuminate the reassurance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Gardens and springs present a positive water-source image that broadly parallels the stream beneath Mary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hearing a caller and answering with prayer gives a related call-and-response pattern, though collective and devotional.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Zakariyya's private call to his Lord offers a same-surah model of a needy human addressed by God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mary's withdrawal while pregnant is the immediate narrative step before her labor and consolation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Punishment from above or beneath the feet is a negative spatial contrast to the saving stream below.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Zakariyya's speech restriction only anticipates the later silence instruction to Mary, not 19:24 itself.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jesus' later proclamation of shared lordship does not clarify the childbirth reassurance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses being called by name shares the direct-address motif but not the maternal consolation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Moses is assured not to fear during escape, a related pattern of divine reassurance in danger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A secure station for the godfearing offers only general safety imagery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stream, spring, and cooled sight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water appears below the laboring woman, becomes drink and green moisture, and cools both body and eye.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lower side beneath the body (`quranic:root_000177:B001/m01`); small running stream and creeping root-water (`quranic:root_000702:B002/m01`); visible spring (`quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`); drinking liquid (`quranic:root_000783:B001/m01`); drinking place or vessel (`quranic:root_000783:B004/m01`); moisture and softness (`quranic:root_000571:B001/m01`); green wet pasture (`quranic:root_000571:B003/m01`); eye cooled into rest (`quranic:root_001215:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 19:24 (ت ح ت, س ر ي); 19:25 (ر ط ب); 19:26 (ش ر ب, ع ي ن, ق ر ر)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The promised stream is both hydrological and affective. Water runs below, rises visibly as a spring, feeds moist growth, enters a vessel and body, and finally cools the eye into settled composure.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dates or raisins cast into a water vessel (`quranic:root_001466:B006/m01`); milk diluted by poured water (`quranic:root_001501:B007/m01`); allotted water share (`quranic:root_000783:B002/m01`); thickened syrup used to improve food or skins (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); recurring turn at water (`quranic:root_000315:B002/m01`); liquid poured at once into a vessel (`quranic:root_001215:B005/m01`)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sesi yükselterek birine seslenme ve çağırma çekirdeğini açıkça verir; ayrıca hem yalın sesi hem de anlam taşıyan sözlü çağrıyı kapsar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sesin erişim uzaklığını, toplantı yerini, ıslaklığı veya cömertliği kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın seslenme dalına bağlıdır ve başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış kullanımları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Birine ulaşmak amacıyla sesi yükselterek seslenme veya çağırma; bu, yalın bir ses de anlam taşıyan sözlü bir çağrı da olabilir.

facets.statement: Bir muhataba sesi yükselterek seslenme ve onu çağırma eylemidir.
Çağrı, yalın bir sesten oluşabileceği gibi anlaşılır bir söz bütünü de olabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, yüksek sesle seslenme ve çağırmayı merkeze alır; çağrının yalnız ses veya anlamlı söz olabileceğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın ses ile anlam taşıyan sözlü çağrının ikisini de kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ses yükseltme, seslenme ve çağırma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiye yüksek sesle yöneldiği eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Muhataba yönelen yüksek sesli çağrı eylemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği yüksek sesle seslenmedir; komşu dal ise çağrının yöneltme, davet ve bir yere sevk etme amaçlarını daha geniş biçimde içerir.

concept_map.definition: Bir sesin çıktıktan sonra ulaştığı uzaklık, sürüp giden erişimi veya son sınırı; belirli karşılaştırma kalıplarında sesin daha uzağa erişmesi ya da daha yüksek çıkmasıdır.

Genel olarak erişilen son sınır veya menzil anlamında da kullanılır.
Karşılaştırmalı bir ses kalıbında daha uzak erişme, daha yüksek çıkma veya güzel ses niteliği bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt sesin uzak erişimini ve menzilini verir; karşılaştırmalı kullanım uzaklık, yükseklik ve ses niteliği çağrışımlarını taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım toplantı yeri çekirdeğini, oraya katılma, insanları toplama ve birlikte oturma kalıplarından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun bir araya gelip oturduğu, konuştuğu ve görüş alışverişinde bulunduğu yer; ad, ancak topluluk oradayken bu anlamı kazanabilir ve yerden oradaki topluluğa aktarılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsanların çevresinde toplanıp konuştuğu ortak toplantı yeridir.
Topluluğun hazır bulunması, yerin bu adla anılması için belirleyici bir koşuldur.
Yer adı, orada bulunan topluluk, yakın çevre veya aynı topluluğun üyeleri için de kullanılabilir.
Bu alana katılma, başkalarını orada toplama, birlikte oturma ve danışma eylemleri de bu dala bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da topluluğun hazır bulunduğu toplantı yerini ve oradaki görüşmeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek, koşullar ve başlıca kapsam aynıdır; iki dal arasında anlam sınırı oluşturan bir ayrım görünmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı toplantı yeri ve topluluk sınırını taşıyan tam eş anlamlı komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النادي والندى والندوة والمنتدى بمعنى مجلس القوم ومتحدثهم ومكان اجتماعهم، ويدخل فيه الجلوس والمشاورة وحضور الندي، ويدخل فيه أهل النادي أو العشيرة إذا سمي المكان بهم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد النداء بالصوت، ولا الندى بمعنى البلل أو الجود.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأول النادي والندى المجلس يندو القوم حواليه وإذا تفرقوا فليس بندى (maqayis)؛ دار الندوة بمكة لأنهم كانوا يندون فيها أي يجتمعون (maqayis)؛ ناديته جالسته في الندى (maqayis)؛ الندى مجلس القوم ومتحدثهم وكذلك الندوة والنادي والمنتدى (sihah)؛ فإن تفرق القوم فليس بندي (sihah)؛ فليدع ناديه أي عشيرته وإنما هم أهل النادي (sihah)؛ ندوت أي حضرت الندي وانتديت مثله (sihah)؛ ندوت القوم جمعتهم في الندي (sihah)؛ النادي المجلس يندو إليه من حواليه ولا يسمى ناديا حتى يكون فيه أهله (tahdhib)؛ أناديك أشاورك وأجالسك من النادي (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن المجالسة بالنداء حتى قيل للمجلس النادي والمنتدى والندي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, deve veya atın sudan yakın otlağa götürülüp kısa süre otlatılmasını ve yeniden suya döndürülmesini; buna bağlı yer ve ara öğün adlarını da açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan otlatmayı değil, su ile yakın otlak arasında dönüşlü ve aşamalı hayvan yönetimini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sınıflandırma yalındır; tanım su, yakın otlak, kısa otlama ve suya dönüş aşamalarının tümünü korur.

concept_map.definition: Deve veya atı suladıktan sonra yakın otlağa götürüp bir süre otlatma ve yeniden suya döndürme; buna, bu döngünün yeri ile iki sulama arasındaki otlama öğünü de bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Hayvan suya getirilir, yakın otlağa çıkarılır ve kısa bir otlamadan sonra yeniden suya döndürülür.
Hareket tuzcul otlaktan taze otlağa geçip geri dönme biçiminde de gerçekleşebilir.
Döngünün gerçekleştiği sulama yeri ile iki sulama arasındaki otlama öğünü aynı dala bağlı adlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, su ile yakın otlak arasındaki dönüşlü hayvan yönetimini verir; yer ve ara otlama öğünü bu sürecin bağlı adlarıdır.

concept_gloss.text: hayvanı su ile yakın otlak arasında döndürme
concept_gloss.applicability: Sulama, kısa süre otlatma ve yeniden suya getirme aşamalarının tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Suya getirme, otlatma ve geri döndürme aşamalarını eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Süreç içindeki ara otlama veya hayvanın yediği öğün adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki sulama arasındaki bağlı otlama öğünü anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: develerin su ile yakın otlak arasında gidip dönmesi
hayvanı sulayıp kısa süre otlattıktan sonra yeniden suya getirme
atın su, otlak ve dönüş döngüsünü yapması
hayvanın su ile otlak arasında döndürüldüğü yer

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, iki sulama arasındaki otlama öğününü de açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, belirli bir anlatımda atı terleyene kadar çalıştırmayı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: hayvanı su ile otlak arasında döndürme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın çekirdeğinde hayvanı sudan yakın otlağa çıkarıp yeniden suya getirme döngüsü vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ana süreç ortaktır; odak dal ara öğünü kapsarken komşu dal belirli bir at çalıştırma uzantısına da sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı döngüyü taşıyıp bağlı uzantılarda ayrılan en yakın komşu yayımlandı.
branches.branch_image_ar: تندية الإبل والخيل بين الماء والمرعى
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ندوة الإبل والتندية في الإبل والخيل، بأن ترد الماء ثم ترعى ساعة أو تنتقل من المشرب إلى المرعى القريب أو من الحمض إلى الخلة ثم تعود، ويدخل فيه موضع الشرب القريب والأكلة بين الشربتين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النادي بمعنى مجلس الناس، ولا الندى بمعنى المطر نفسه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ندوة الإبل أن تندو من المشرب إلى المرعى القريب منه ثم تعود إلى الماء (maqayis)؛ وكذلك تندو من الحمض إلى الخلة وأندى إبله من هذا (maqayis)؛ ندت الإبل إذا رعت فيما بين النهل والعلل فهي نادية (sihah)؛ أنديتها أنا ونديتها تندية والموضع مندى (sihah)؛ الندوة بالضم موضع شرب الإبل (sihah)؛ التندية في الإبل والخيل أن يوردها الماء ثم يردها إلى المرعى ساعة ثم يعيدها (tahdhib)؛ وقد ندا الفرس يندو إذا فعل ذلك (tahdhib)؛ الندى الأكلة بين الشربتين (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ıslaklık ve nemi çekirdek olarak verir; yağmur, çiy, ıslanmış nesne ile nemli gün, gece ve yer kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitki ve yağ için kullanılan bağlı adlar bu dalın kendisi değil, ayrı sonuç veya aktarım dallarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel ıslaklık çekirdeğini korur ve yerin nemini bildiren kalıpla sınırlı kullanımı ayrıca gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeye ulaşan ıslaklık ve nem; yağmur, çiy, nesnenin ıslanması ile yerin, günün ya da gecenin nemli olması buna bağlı gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Islaklık ve nem durumudur; yağmur ve çiy bu çekirdeğin örnek gerçekleşmeleridir.
Bir nesnenin ıslanması ve yer, gün veya gecenin nemli olması bu durumun gerçekleşmeleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt ıslaklık ve nem çekirdeğinde birleşir; yağmur, çiy, ıslanma ve nemli zaman ya da yer kullanımları bu çekirdeği gerçekleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: ıslaklık ve nem; yağmur ve çiy
concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin ıslanmasıyla yer ve zamanın nemli oluşunu birlikte kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Islaklık, nem, yağmur ve çiy bağlantılarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin su veya çiy etkisiyle ıslak duruma gelmesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin nem ve ıslaklık kazanması anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bitki ve yağ kullanımlarını ayrı dallara bırakır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bitki ve yağ adlarını da ıslaklıkla ilişkileri bakımından aynı kapsamda anar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yağmur ve çiyden gelen ıslaklık ile yerin ve nesnenin nemini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Islaklık çekirdeği aynıdır; komşu dal, bu kökten türetilen bitki ve yağ adlarını daha geniş bir ilişkisel çerçevede içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı ıslaklık çekirdeğini daha geniş sonuçlarla birleştiren komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى البلل والرطوبة والمطر والطل، وندى الشيء إذا ابتل، والأرض أو اليوم أو الليلة الندية.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو الندى بمعنى الجود، ولا الشحم أو النبت إلا من جهة أنهما يذكران فرعين ناشئين عن البلل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأصل الآخر الندى من البلل معروف (maqayis)؛ الندى المطر والبلل (sihah)؛ ندى الأرض نداوتها وبللها (sihah)؛ ندي الشيء إذا ابتل فهو ند (sihah)؛ ندى الماء فمنه المطر أصابه ندى من طل ويوم ندي وليلة ندية (tahdhib)؛ الندى ما أصابك من البلل (tahdhib)؛ أصل النداء من الندى أي الرطوبة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi otlak bitkisini ve ağacı adlandırır, ayrıca bu adlandırmayı yağmur nemiyle yetişen sonucun sebebinin adıyla anılmasına bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yağmurun veya nemin kendisini değil, onunla yetişen otlak bitkisini ve ağacı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bitki adı olan genel kullanımla nemle yetişmiş ağacı bildiren kalıplaşmış kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Yağmurun ve nemin etkisiyle yetişen otlak bitkisi, ot veya ağaç; sonuç, onu yetiştiren ıslaklığın adıyla anılır.

facets.statement: Hayvanın yiyebileceği otlak bitkisi, ot veya ağaçtır.
Bitkinin adı, onu ortaya çıkaran yağmur ve nem sebebinden aktarılmıştır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt ot, otlak bitkisi ve ağacı kapsar; adlandırma, bitkinin yağmur neminden yetişmesiyle açıklanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ot, otlak bitkisi ve bunlarla birlikte anılan ağaç kullanımını sebep ilişkisiyle kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Bitki, otlak ve yağmur neminden yetişme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağaç için kullanılan ve yetişme sebebini vurgulayan sınırlı kalıpta uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ağacın nemle yetişmiş olma niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yağmur nemiyle yetişen ot ve otlak bitkisi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bitki adını özellikle yağmur neminden yetişme sebebiyle ilişkilendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yeryüzünde hayvanların yediği bütün otlak ve yem bitkilerini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: otlak ve hayvan yemi olan bitki
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da hayvanların otladığı ot ve yeryüzü bitkileri bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı yönü yağmur nemiyle yetişme ve sebepten sonuca ad aktarımıdır; komşu dal daha genel bir yem ve otlak sınıfıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel otlak bitkisi ile yağmur nemine bağlı adlandırma arasındaki sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الكلأ أو النبت، والشجر المسمى ندى لكونه من الندى.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو المطر نفسه، ولا الشحم الذي يكون عن النبت.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الندى الكلأ (sihah)؛ تسف الند (sihah)؛ قيل للنبت ندى لأنه عن ندى المطر نبت (tahdhib)؛ يسمى الشجر ندى لكونه منه وذلك لتسمية المسبب باسم سببه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı doğrudan hayvan yağı için verir ve adlandırmayı, yağın nemle yetişen bitkiden oluşmasına bağlayan açıklamayı destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yağmur, ıslaklık veya bitkinin kendisi değil, bunlarla beslenme sonucu oluşan hayvan yağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan yağı anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve ıslaklık ya da bitki dallarını doğrudan anlam saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Hayvan yağı; adın, hayvanın nemle yetişen bitkiyle beslenmesi sonucu oluşan yağa aktarılmış olduğu açıklanır.

facets.statement: Hayvan bedeninde bulunan yağdır.
Adlandırma, yağın nemle yetişen bitkiden beslenme sonucu oluşmasıyla açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım hayvan yağını verir; nemli bitkiden beslenme, adın bu anlama aktarılmasının gerekçesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan yağı çekirdeğini karşılar; nemli bitkiyle beslenme bağı adlandırmanın gerekçesidir.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan yağı çekirdeğini korur ve adlandırma gerekçesini uygulama açıklamasında belirtir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hayvan yağını genel olarak ve bitkisel beslenme bağıyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız koyunun karın zarındaki belirli bir yağ dokusunu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hayvan bedenindeki yenebilir yağ dokusunu konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel hayvan yağıdır; komşu dal ise belirli bir hayvanın belirli anatomik bölgesindeki yağla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel hayvan yağı ile belirli anatomik yağ arasındaki en açık sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الشحم، وخاصة حين يفسر بأنه يكون عن ندى النبت.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو المطر أو البلل نفسه، ولا الجود.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ربما عبروا عن الشحم بالندى (maqayis)؛ الندى الشحم (sihah)؛ فالندى الأول المطر والثاني الشحم (sihah)؛ قيل للشحم ندى لأنه عن ندى النبت يكون (tahdhib)؛ أراد بالندى الثاني الشحم وبالأول الغيث (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi eli açıklık, bol iyilik, verme ve arkadaşlarına karşı cömert davranma kullanımlarını tek bir cömertlik çekirdeğinde birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel nemi değil, iyilik ve malı isteyerek ve bolca verme niteliğini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel cömertlik anlamını korur; el, arkadaş çevresi ve birinden pay alma kalıplarını ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: İyilik, mal veya yarar sağlamada eli açık olma ve çevresindekilere bolca verme; belirli kalıplarda bu cömertliğin derecesi ya da birinden pay elde etme anlatılır.

facets.statement: İyilik ve mal vermede eli açık, cömert ve bol verici olma niteliğidir.
Karşılaştırma, arkadaşlarına cömert davranma ve birinden cömertlik payı elde etme kalıpları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım cömertlik, bol iyilik ve verme üzerinde birleşir; el ve arkadaş çevresi kalıpları bu niteliğin kişiler arası gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Cömert kişilik niteliğini ve başkalarına bolca verme davranışını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İyilik, cömertlik, eli açıklık ve bol verme unsurlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Cömertliğin özellikle kişinin arkadaş çevresine yöneldiği kalıplaşmış bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çevresindekilere yönelen cömert davranışı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ondan hiçbir cömertlik payı elde etmedim

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, eli açıklığı ve arkadaş çevresine bol verme kalıplarını özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal malın yanında bilgiyi verme ve daha geniş özne türlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da mal veya yarar sunmada cömertlik ve eli açıklık vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek büyük ölçüde ortaktır; odak dal belirli el ve arkadaşlık kalıplarına bağlıyken komşu dal verme nesnesi ve özne bakımından daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel cömertlik ile bu dalın el ve arkadaş çevresi kalıplarını karşılaştıran komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الندى بمعنى الجود والعطاء والمعروف والخير، وندي الكف، وأندى الرجل أو تندى إذا تسخى أو كثر عطاؤه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو البلل الحسي، ولا الإصابة بالمكروه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: هو أندى من فلان أي أكثر خيرا منه (maqayis)؛ وهو يتندى على أصحابه أي يتسخى (maqayis)؛ الندى الجود (sihah)؛ فلان ندي الكف إذا كان سخيا (sihah)؛ فلان يتندى على أصحابه أي يتسخى (sihah)؛ الندوة السخاء (tahdhib)؛ ندى الخير هو المعروف (tahdhib)؛ أندى الرجل إذا كثر نداه على إخوانه وكذلك انتدى وتندى (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن السخاء بالندى (mufradat)؛ فلان أندى كفا من فلان وهو يتندى على أصحابه أي يتسخى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi istenmeyen veya kötü bir şeye uğrama ve bulaşma ile utandıran söz veya davranışları aynı olumsuz etkilenme alanında toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kötülüğün soyut varlığından çok, kişiye ulaşması, ona bulaşması veya onu utandırmasıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım olumsuz etkilenme çekirdeğini, kötülüğe bulaşma ve utandırıcı sözler için kullanılan kalıplardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin istemediği, kötü veya yasak bir şeye uğraması ya da bulaşması; ayrıca bilinen ve sahibini utandıran söz veya davranışlar bu alana girer.

facets.statement: Kişiye istemediği veya kötü bir şeyin ulaşması ve onu olumsuz etkilemesidir.
Yasak kana bulaşma gibi ağır bir kötülüğe karışma kullanımı vardır.
Sahibini utandıran ve bilinen sözler veya davranışlar için çoğul bir ad olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt istenmeyen şeye uğrama, kötülüğe bulaşma ve utandırıcı söz ya da davranışlar arasında olumsuz etkilenme bağı kurar.

concept_gloss.text: kötü bir şeye uğrama veya bulaşma ve utandırıcı şeyler
concept_gloss.applicability: İstenmeyen etkinin kişiye ulaşmasını, kötülüğe bulaşmayı ve utandırıcı şeyleri birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Uğrama, bulaşma, kötülük ve utandırıcılık unsurlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişiyi toplum önünde utandıran bilinen söz veya davranışların çoğul adında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinen ve sahibini utandıran söz veya davranış anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kötü etkinin kişiye ulaşmasını ve utandırıcı sözlerin adlandırılmasını özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kötülük, suç, zarar, borç ve yergiyi daha geniş bir kirlenme alanında toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin kötü veya kınanabilir bir şeyle lekelenmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uğrama ve utandırıcı görünür sonuç üzerinde durur; komşu dal ise kötülük, suç ve zararın daha geniş türlerini kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; olumsuz etkilenme ile geniş kötülük lekesi arasındaki en yararlı sınır yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما نديت بشيء تكرهه أو بشر، وما نديت كفي، ويتند من الدم الحرام، والمنديات أو منديات الكلم بمعنى المخزيات.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli bir kalıpta, dişi devenin soy bakımından seçkin develere çekmesini ve onların özelliklerini göstermesini anlatır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel soy veya soyluluk adı değildir; yalnız dişi devenin seçkin bir deve soyuna çekmesini bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen dişi deve ve seçkin deve soyu kalıbına bağlıdır; yalın kök anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir söz kalıbında, bir dişi devenin soy bakımından seçkin develere çekmesi ve onların kalıtsal özelliklerini göstermesi.

facets.statement: Dişi devenin soy bakımından seçkin bir deve topluluğuna çekmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dişi devenin soyca seçkin develere çekmesini aynı kalıpla ve aynı sınırla aktarır.

concept_gloss.text: dişi devenin seçkin bir soya çekmesi

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir canlının değerli ve seçkin bir soya bağlılığı söz konusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir dişi deve benzerliği kalıbıdır; komşu dal daha genel ve iki ebeveyn yönünü kapsayan soylu köken alanıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi görünür hâle gelmeyi, birine bildirmeyi ve yolun açıkça yön göstermesini, yükselen bir ses kadar belirgin olma benzetmesiyle birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek bir seslenme gerektirmez; ortak nokta bir şeyin belirginleşmesi veya açıkça bilgi vermesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın belirme kullanımıyla birine bildirme ve yolun yön göstermesi kalıplarını birbirinden ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin yükselen bir ses gibi açık ve belirgin biçimde ortaya çıkması; ayrıca birine bir şeyi bildirme veya yolun görünüşüyle yön göstermesi.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin dikkat çekecek kadar açık ve belirgin biçimde görünür olmasıdır.
Birine bilgi verme ve yolun görünüşüyle yön göstermesi bu belirginlikten doğan kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt belirgin biçimde ortaya çıkmayı merkeze alır; bildirme ve yolun yön göstermesi bu görünürlükten türeyen kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.text: açıkça belirme, bildirme ve yön gösterme
concept_gloss.applicability: Görünür olma çekirdeğini ve bundan doğan bilgi verme ile yol gösterme kullanımlarını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Belirme, belirginlik, bildirme ve yön gösterme unsurlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolun görünüşü veya açıklığıyla kişiye gideceği yönü gösterdiği kalıpta kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdek ve kapsam aynıdır; gerçek seslenmeden belirgin görünüşe yapılan aktarım iki dalda da aynı sınırı taşır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نادى بمعنى ظهر، وناديته بمعنى علمته، وهذا الطريق يناديك، وما ظهر ظهور صوت المنادي.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir nesne sınıfı vermez: zaman zaman çıkan sözleri, yan ve uzak uçları, ayrılıp uzaklaşmayı ve sudan uzaktaki hurma ağaçlarını ayrı kullanımlar olarak sıralar. Bu nedenle tanım bunları tek bir yalın anlammış gibi birleştirmeden korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, aralıklı çıkma ile merkezden veya sudan uzak kalma kullanımlarını ayrı yüzler olarak tutar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel uzaklaşma biçimleriyle söz ve ağaçlara bağlı sınırlı kullanımları birbirine karıştırmadan gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir bağlamda sözlerin zaman zaman ve parça parça çıkması; başka bağlamlarda yanlar veya uzak uçlar, kişinin ayrılıp uzaklaşması ve sudan uzakta kalan hurma ağaçları için kullanılan bir kullanım kümesi.

facets.statement: Sözlerin bir kerede değil, zaman zaman ve parça parça ağızdan çıkmasını anlatır.
Bir bütünün yanlarını, uzak uçlarını veya merkezden uzak kesimlerini bildirir.
Bir kişinin ayrılıp uzaklaşması ve hurma ağaçlarının sudan uzakta bulunması mesafe yüzünü gerçekleştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt tek kaynaktaki aralıklı söz, uzak uç, ayrılma ve sudan uzak hurma ağacı kullanımlarını ayrı ayrı korur.

source_details.summary: Sözlerin zaman zaman çıkması, uzak yanlar, ayrılıp uzaklaşma ve sudan uzaktaki hurma ağaçları birlikte kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.text: aralıklı çıkan sözler ve uzakta kalan uçlar
concept_gloss.applicability: Heterojen dalı tek anlam saymadan aralıklı çıkma ve uzaklık yüzlerini en kısa biçimde birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Aralıklı çıkma, uzak uç, uzaklaşma ve uzakta kalma yüzlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin topluluktan veya bulunduğu yerden çekilip uzaklaşması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin ayrılma ve uzaklaşma eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurma ağaçlarının sulama kaynağından uzakta bulunmasını anlatan sınırlı kullanımda uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel uzaklaşma, geri çekilme ve geniş uzak alanı daha doğrudan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da merkezden veya başlangıç noktasından uzaklaşma ilişkisi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzaklığı belirli ad ve kalıplarda, ayrıca aralıklı söz kullanımıyla verir; komşu dal daha genel bir uzaklaşma eylemidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نوادي الكلام أي ما يخرج وقتا بعد وقت، والنوادي بمعنى النواحي أو القواصي، وندا فلان إذا اعتزل وتنحى، والناديات من النخيل البعيدة من الماء.

İz ve şerit çerçevesi pişirme kullanımını tek başına açıklamadığı için iki yüz açıkça ayrılmıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, ses kesmesiz diğer dallardan ayrılır ve renk izi ile pişirme kullanımlarını ayrı yüzler olarak korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ses kesmeli türevlerle sınırlıdır; renk izi biçimleri ile eti külde pişirme kalıbını birbirine genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Ses kesmeli türevlerde, etin renginden farklı bir yağ şeridi, gökkuşağı veya buluttaki kızıllık; ayrı bir kullanımda eti sıcak kül içine gömüp pişirme ve bunun pişmiş ürünü.

facets.statement: Bir yüzeyde çevresinden farklı görünen renk şeridi veya izdir.
Etin renginden farklı yağ şeridi, gökkuşağı ve buluttaki kızıllık bu görünür izin örnekleridir.
Ayrı bir kullanım eti sıcak kül içine gömerek pişirmeyi ve ortaya çıkan pişmiş yemeği anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt tek kaynakta etin renginden farklı yağ şeridi ve göksel renk izi kullanımlarıyla sıcak külde pişirme kullanımını ayrı yüzler olarak verir.

source_details.summary: Etin renginden farklı yağ şeridi, gökkuşağı, bulut kızıllığı, sıcak külde et pişirme ve pişmiş ürün birlikte kaydedilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanların çevresinde toplandığı yer ile orada oluşan toplantıyı aynı çekirdekte birleştirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu yer, topluluk ve görüşme bağını doğru biçimde temsil eder; danışma ise toplantının olası işlevi olarak kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği toplantı ve toplantı yeridir; seslenme, ıslaklık ve cömertlik anlamları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, toplantı yeri ve toplanmış topluluk çekirdeğini verir; katılma, toplama, birlikte oturma ve danışma anlamları yalnız tanıklanmış yapılara bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun buluşup konuştuğu yer ile o yerde oluşan toplantıyı anlatır. Yer adı, orada bulunan topluluğu da kapsayabilir.

facets.statement: İnsanların çevresinde toplandığı buluşma yeri ve bu yerdeki topluluk toplantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, insanların çevresinde toplandığı buluşma yerini, oradaki toplantıyı ve yer adıyla anılabilen topluluğu ortak çekirdek olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer ile orada toplanan insanları birlikte kapsayan dal çekirdeğinin tamamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Buluşma yerini, toplantıyı ve toplanmış topluluk bağını birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: Toplantı olayını ve yer adıyla anılan topluluğu tek başına belirtmez.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النداء صوتا، ولا الندى بللا أو جودا، ولا ندو الإبل بين الماء والمرعى.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çağırmayı, bağırarak ses yöneltmeyi, sesin yükselip belirginleşmesini ve uzağa erişmesini birlikte verir. Dal çerçevesi bu eylem ile sesin menzili arasındaki bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek işitme değil, ses çıkarıp birine yöneltme ve sesin duyulur biçimde yükselmesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çağırma ve yükseltilmiş ses çekirdeğini kapsar; ibadete çağrı ile ses menzili karşılaştırmaları yalnız tanıklanmış yapılarda geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Birine ulaşmak veya onu çağırmak için sesi yükseltip belirgin biçimde yöneltmeyi anlatır. Sesin uzağa yayılması ve eriştiği mesafe de bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Birine yönelik yüksek, açık ve duyulur bir ses çıkarma ya da çağırma eylemidir.
Çıkarılan sesin uzağa yayılması ve başka bir sesten daha uzak bir menzile erişmesi de anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek sesle çağırma ve seslenme çekirdeğinde birleşir; ayrıca sesin belirginliği, yükselmesi ve uzak mesafeye erişmesi aynı anlam alanına bağlanır.

error_profile.loses: Sesin uzaklığa erişen menzilini ve menzil karşılaştırmasını belirtmez.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin yayılma mesafesini ve uzak erişimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kişiyi çağırma eylemini tek başına anlatmaz.
